user.title: Connect your ADA PTM-1645
user.description: Select a local RS-232 port or ESPHome serial proxy. The amplifier must use its default one-to-one trigger mapping. Setup reads the amplifier without changing any zones.

data_description.address: Existing PAC address, from 1 to 9. This does not change the amplifier's address.

reconfigure.title: Change the ADA connection
reconfigure.description: The integration will reconnect using these settings. Zone entity IDs are preserved. If the amplifier cannot be reached, setup will retry automatically.

error.cannot_connect: No valid amplifier response. Check the port, PAC address, RS-232 wiring and that the old ESPHome scripts are removed. The connection uses 19200 baud, 8N1, with no flow control.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured. Only one amplifier per connection is supported.
abort.no_changes: The connection settings have not changed.

command_failed.message: The amplifier did not confirm the command. Check the serial connection and try again.
